titles: The World Tree and the tower
descriptions: A vast grassland surrounds the World Tree and a lone magic tower.
Finn joins Mira for breakfast on the terrace.
Finn chats while Mira tries to read.
Mira uses a physical spell card to hold a book and napkin against the wind.
Professor Orin calls the two students to his office.
Orin sends Mira to the World Tree and Finn to the stone golem village.
The students ask about their research. Orin insists on direct observation.
Mira and Finn help each other pack for the journey.
Orin sees them off the following morning.
They promise to have a beer together that evening, then take separate paths.
Finn approaches the golems' rocky habitat, greets them and begins observing.
Finn studies deep footprints. A small golem peers at his notebook.
Finn and a small golem roll pebbles. A pebble rolls under a slab.
The golem and Finn cannot reach the pebble by hand.
Finn draws a spell card and asks the small golem to stand back.
Finn lifts the stone with a card. The small golem retrieves its pebble.
The golem rolls its pebble back to Finn, asking to play again.
Finn names his new companion Mok.
Finn sketches Mok and shows him the drawing.
Mok's eyes turn red. He ignores Finn and walks toward a dark cave.
dialogue: I might find out if you'd let me read.

Where they live. How they move.
